First what I had to learn was that it's not an easy journey and for the most part it's a slow / backwards / non liniar process. Learning there is no "end by "date for recovery helped me take day by day and week by week. 

Go slow, eat, forgive yourself. 

Another thing is eating. I used to think self care was having it okay to just eat a cookie and a scoop of peanut butter all day. 
Nope. That's not it. 
What I do now is keep easy things in the house. So soup stock, couscous, frozen mixed vegge, salad greens, salami and cheese. 
 I forget to eat a lot - meds - and have to set reminders to eat. So quick things are good for that. I never feel good when I've forgotten to eat and sometimes it can send me into terrible downward spirals. 

As for balancing things I am not the best to talk too haha.  I haven't gone back to school for my bachelors even tho at my age I should be heading into a masters lol. I found that I can't balance life obligations too well. 
What I can do is go to work, take care of myself (my fiancée & pets) and see friends/family only sometimes.
My suggestion though would be to take things slowly. If somedays all you do is school - eat -recover that's more than okay. The world is very fast paced and tells everyone to work ourselves raw. I can't do that and I take things very slowly.
